document.abstract: Procedures outlined in this paper will attempt to compare black-and-white and color TV. Some procedures were developed and tested on a theoretical basis; others evolved after practical experience in color TV production. These techniques and procedures are offered with the intent of making commonplace the means for presenting creative color pictures which satisfy existing technical standards.
